name: SourceWizard
title: Templates/Platform/Create/SourceWizard
summary: A creation wizard that starts a resource from a code source and deploys it: the creation header, a Stepper rail that only lets you go back, the form column, and a borderless fading SaveBar footer with Cancel on the left and Back plus the primary action on the right, the primary hidden while a step is answered by a click. It opens on Where it runs, a centred chooser of the service the project deploys to, six at a time with a search, an inline Create Service row and a way to continue without one; then a card of three methods (Import from Git, Sync with the CLI, Start from a template), each of which declares the remaining steps on the rail. Import from Git connects an account (an EmptyState with a loading Connect button), then lists its repositories with an account select, a search, skeleton rows while they load and a no-match line. Start from a template filters the templates with a PropertyFilter, grouped under sticky headings with Featured tags; a cloned template then asks for a new repository (name with a privacy switch) or an existing one, and an integration template asks for its settings and previews what gets added. The last step reads back the answers with Change, then Name, Domain (environment and certificate once a custom domain is typed), the build and deploy commands in an Accordion that tags an edited command, an opt-in firewall binding with existing or new and a locked DDoS module, and a collapsed Advanced section of module and behavior switches. The provisioning and success screens are DeploymentFlow and DeploySuccess. Built from `PageHeader`, `GlobalHeader`, `Stepper`, `Card`, `Item`, `Field`, `Input`, `InputGroup`, `Select`, `PropertyFilter`, `EmptyState`, `Skeleton`, `ToggleGroup`, `Switch`, `Tooltip`, `Tag`, `Alert`, `Accordion`, `SettingRow`, `SettingsSection`, `HelperText`, `Button` and `SaveBar`.

variants.name: Method
variants.summary: service-01 chosen: the page heading appears over How do you want to start?, a flush card of the three methods with a chevron each, and Cancel and Back in the footer, since picking a method is the answer.

variants.name: GitSource
variants.summary: Import from Git with the account connected: an account Select and a search over the repository list, each row with its framework mark and when it was updated, and Cancel and Back in the footer, since picking a repository answers the step.

variants.name: TemplateSource
variants.summary: Start from a template: a PropertyFilter (search, Type, Use case) over the templates grouped under sticky Official, Community and Frameworks headings, the first three frameworks tagged Featured; picking one answers the step.

variants.name: Repository
variants.summary: Next.js Commerce chosen: New repository or Existing repository, the Account select, the repository name prefilled with a privacy switch in a tooltip, and Back plus Next, which shows the required message when the name is empty.

variants.name: Configure
variants.summary: storefront-checkout imported: the read-back row with Change, Name prefilled, Domain with its info alert, the build and deploy commands Accordion that tags an edited command, the firewall switch off, Advanced collapsed, and Back plus Create and deploy.

variants.name: Install
variants.summary: The Origin Proxy integration chosen: the read-back row, its settings with the required Origin address, What gets added previewing the origin and the request-phase rule on service-01, and Back plus Add to service-01.

variants.name: ConnectFailed
variants.summary: Import from Git on service-01 after the GitHub authorization failed: the Connect a Git account state stays, with a small danger `Alert` under Connect GitHub; pressing it again retries.

variants.name: LoadFailed
variants.summary: Import from Git with the acme account connected, but its repositories failed to load: a danger `Alert` with Retry takes the place of the list, while the account Select and the search stay usable.
